outcome: breastmilk feeding (BF) initiation at hospital discharge
breastmilk feeding (BF) continuation at 6 weeks postpartum
cohort: The cohort consisted of pregnant persons admitted with preterm prelabor rupture of membranes (PPROM) to a single tertiary center between 2013-2019, excluding those with intrauterine or neonatal demise or incomplete BF data.
finding: Tobacco use in pregnancy was associated with non-initiation of BF, while private insurance and longer pregnancy latency were associated with BF initiation; maternal age <20 years and multiparity were associated with BF cessation, and private insurance was associated with BF continuation.
